name: Mercy Seat
overview: The Mercy Seat, crafted by Bezaleel as a freewill offering of pure gold, was placed upon the ark of the testimony as commanded by Moses. It featured two cherubim of beaten gold at its ends, whose wings covered the Mercy Seat and whose faces looked toward each other, symbolizing God's presence. Above this sacred cover, God promised to meet and commune with His people, speaking from between the cherubim, making the Mercy Seat the visible throne of divine fellowship and grace.
